'''Hak Eraag''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living in the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hak Eraag appears as a slicing trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
